games.name: (QOL + DESTRUCTION) NPC Builders Demo
games.desc:
You can make NPCs build whatever you want within this game.

These NPCs use a structured algorithm from the toolbox made by me in order to create builds. In other words: No, it does not use generative AI.

The NPC mimics the usage of F3X Builder tools to create objects in the world.

(Note: Turns out someone made a game called "Clone Builders" inspired by this project. I'm honestly really happy to know that someone out there thought my work was cool enough to take inspiration off of!)

games.desc:
🔨 Shutdown = Update/Bug Fixes
If you find any bugs, please report them to the community!

New Icon was made by @lolkek, thank you for submitting art!

Welcome to Robotomy Corporation 

Your job here is to manage abnormalities and to collect energy.
Death is not an end to your work. There is no living in here. Good luck.

What you can do in this game:
- 📝 Start working on abnormalities and start getting PE-Boxes to meet the energy quota! 
- ⚔️ Suppress abnormalities and bring them back to their containment!
- ❤️ Assist your team members and start working as a team
- 👨‍💼 Be a manager and use your iron fist to run the company.

Controls:
Tab - View stats
Mouse Scroll - Zoom camera
Click on Containment Door - Work with abnormalities
R - Special for certain weapons

This game is largely inspired by Lobotomy Corporation. 

A remake is being worked on. This game will have a final update on v2.0.
